title: The Doomsday Church Of The Nerds
content:
Review of The Nerd Reich by Gil Durán: One of the most fascinating aspects of the book is its description of a milieu that takes on the character of a religious doomsday cult. Drawing on research on fascism, the author highlights the alliance between economic elites and an authoritarian mass movement, the contempt for the limitations of democracy, and the notion that society must be saved from internal enemies.

We thought they were happy, freedom-loving hippies. Eccentric nerds who had brought the 1960s’ dreams of a better world into the computer age. They wanted to connect us, give everyone a voice and free us from dusty institutions. Who could object to that?

And all of a sudden, there was Elon Musk making a gesture that looked like a Nazi salute, while Peter Thiel was on the lecture circuit talking about the Antichrist. How did we get from peace, love and personal computers to MAGA and the Book of Revelation?
